decision: The latest accepted real report is the fixed format for future one-click reports. Do not redesign it during routine development.
comparison_display: one selected comparison; shared study QC retained; declared cross-comparison groups retained
network_display: direct module graph plus complete searchable, paged and downloadable gene/event lists; drawing limits explicit
motif_display: up to ten distinct models with recorded native test FDR <= 0.05; concise no-significance notice when none qualify
default_das: RS-DAS; ordinary DAS switch retained report-wide where supported
complete_results_storage: canonical byte-identical copies and lossless complete-table compression; no row truncation
acceptance_boundary: Real bulk report format and delivered reference accepted. Additional assays, pipeline entries, distribution and current CI have separate acceptance evidence.
change_rule: Update data and results in this format. Changes to format or agreed scientific defaults require a new explicit user decision; technical fixes preserving it may proceed.
